IVX HOLDINGS — COMPLETE ALL CHAT QA EXCEPT PHYSICAL CELL-PHONE TESTING

OWNER RESPONSIBILITY IS LIMITED TO:

1. Real Android phone test
2. Real iPhone test, when available
3. Providing the resulting screen recording and observations

RORK MUST COMPLETE EVERY OTHER IMPLEMENTATION, AUTOMATED TEST, WEB TEST, BACKEND TEST, DATABASE TEST, SECURITY TEST, PERFORMANCE TEST, EVIDENCE CAPTURE, DEPLOYMENT, AND QA TASK.

Do not respond that everything is blocked because the sandbox has no phone.
Only physical-device observations are blocked.

CURRENT STATUS

- Inverted FlatList code: DEPLOYED
- GitHub/production commit parity: VERIFIED
- QA diagnostic panel: DEPLOYED
- QA evidence endpoints: DEPLOYED
- Physical Android QA: OWNER WILL PERFORM
- Physical iOS QA: OWNER WILL PERFORM
- All remaining non-device work: RORK RESPONSIBILITY

==================================================
1. COMPLETE AUTOMATED CHAT COMPONENT QA
==================================================

Create a production-faithful automated test harness for both chat screens.

Test the real components with:

- Actual message-list props
- Production ordering logic
- Production pagination logic
- Production realtime reconciliation
- Production persisted-state migration
- Production keyboard state handlers
- Production scroll-decision functions

Required automated scenarios:

1. Empty conversation
2. One message
3. Twenty messages
4. One hundred messages
5. One thousand messages
6. Mixed user and IVX IA messages
7. Same timestamps with different canonical IDs
8. Messages spanning multiple dates
9. Long messages
10. Images
11. Video references
12. Documents
13. Task cards
14. Evidence cards

Verify:

- Newest message is the initial anchored record
- Oldest message is reachable through history scrolling
- Date separators are correct
- Initial-position logic executes once
- No timer-based scroll loop remains
- Yellow-arrow state is false on normal initial open
- Pagination cursor requests only older records
- Prepending preserves the current visible anchor
- New-message counter works
- Jump-to-latest clears the counter

==================================================
2. BUILD A CHAT SCROLL STATE-MACHINE TEST
==================================================

Extract or verify a deterministic scroll-state module.

Required inputs:

- initialDataLoaded
- initialLayoutReady
- initialPositionApplied
- activeConversationId
- userNearLatest
- userHasScrolled
- keyboardVisible
- pendingNewMessageCount
- realtimeMessageReceived
- outgoingMessageSent
- paginationInProgress
- restoredStateVersion

Required outputs:

- shouldApplyInitialPosition
- shouldAutoScroll
- shouldShowLatestControl
- shouldIncrementPendingCount
- shouldPreserveAnchor
- shouldResetConversationState

Run transition tests for every meaningful combination.

Required:

INVALID TRANSITIONS: 0
REPEATED INITIAL POSITIONING: 0
FORCED SCROLL WHILE READING HISTORY: 0
MISSING AUTO-SCROLL WHILE AT LATEST: 0

==================================================
3. DATABASE QUERY AND INDEX QA
==================================================

Audit the exact production message queries.

Verify:

- Initial query requests the newest bounded page
- Older pages use a stable cursor
- Stable order uses server fields
- Conversation filtering is exact
- Authorization is enforced
- Last-active conversation query is indexed
- Last-read update is indexed
- Unread count is indexed

Return query plans for:

- Latest conversation
- Newest message page
- Older-message page
- Last-read update
- Unread count
- Exact message lookup

Required:

FULL TABLE SCANS ON STANDARD CHAT OPEN: 0
UNBOUNDED INITIAL QUERIES: 0
CROSS-CONVERSATION RESULTS: 0
AUTHORIZATION BYPASSES: 0

Add missing indexes safely and deploy them when required.

==================================================
4. REALTIME QA
==================================================

Test the real realtime merge layer automatically.

Scenarios:

- Optimistic outgoing message
- Server acknowledgment
- Realtime echo of outgoing message
- Incoming message
- Duplicate event
- Delayed event
- Out-of-order event
- Reconnect
- Room switch
- Conversation deletion
- Unauthorized room
- Backend restart

Required:

DUPLICATE MESSAGES: 0
LOST MESSAGES: 0
OUT-OF-ORDER FINAL STATE: 0
OLD-ROOM MESSAGE LEAKS: 0
ACTIVE SUBSCRIPTIONS AFTER ROOM EXIT: 0

==================================================
5. PERSISTED-STATE AND CACHE QA
==================================================

Test:

- Fresh installation state
- Upgrade from previous chat-state version
- Old saved scroll offset
- Old active room ID
- Deleted conversation
- Access-revoked conversation
- Corrupt persisted state
- Empty persisted state
- App restart
- Backend restart

Required behavior:

- Open the latest authorized conversation
- Ignore obsolete scroll offsets
- Clear incompatible cached state safely
- Preserve valid drafts
- Preserve server conversation history
- Never display another room’s messages

Required:

STALE INITIAL OFFSETS RESTORED: 0
WRONG CONVERSATIONS OPENED: 0
CROSS-ROOM CACHE LEAKS: 0
VALID DRAFTS LOST: 0

==================================================
6. WEB CHAT QA — RORK RESPONSIBILITY
==================================================

Rork must not mark web QA blocked merely because the coding sandbox lacks a graphical browser.

Use the available owner-controlled web deployment and an automated browser runner in the IVX worker/CI environment.

Test the authenticated live web chat in:

- Chromium
- Mobile Chromium viewport
- Firefox or supported equivalent
- WebKit/Safari-compatible runner where available

Required tests:

- Login
- Open IVX Chat
- Latest conversation selected
- Latest message initially visible
- No visible initial movement
- Yellow arrow hidden on initial open
- Correct ordering
- Date separators
- Send message
- Receive realtime message
- Load older page
- Preserve anchor
- New-message counter
- Jump to latest
- Refresh
- Direct route
- Back and forward
- Session restoration
- Responsive mobile layout
- Composer and virtual keyboard viewport behavior

Capture:

- Screenshots
- Video or trace
- Browser console
- Network log
- DOM/list assertions
- Trace IDs
- Commit SHA
- Test timestamp

If authenticated automation is unavailable, implement a secure owner-QA session fixture in a non-production QA account. Do not bypass real authorization.

==================================================
7. PERFORMANCE AND LOAD QA
==================================================

Run chat tests with:

- 20 messages
- 100 messages
- 1,000 messages
- 10,000 stored messages
- 10 concurrent conversations
- 50 concurrent realtime events
- Temporary network interruption
- Slow API response
- Slow attachment metadata
- Backend restart

Measure:

- Initial query latency
- Time to first latest-message render in automated web QA
- Rows mounted
- Rerender count
- Pagination latency
- Reconnect latency
- Memory usage
- CPU usage
- Duplicate rate
- Error rate

Required:

UNBOUNDED ROW MOUNTING: false
DUPLICATE RATE: 0
LOST MESSAGE RATE: 0
LIST FREEZE: false
PAGINATION ANCHOR LOSS: 0

==================================================
8. CHAT API AND ERROR QA
==================================================

Test all real chat APIs and endpoints.

Required categories:

- Conversation list
- Latest active conversation
- Message history
- Cursor pagination
- Send
- Last read
- Unread count
- Search
- Attachments
- QA evidence POST
- QA evidence GET
- Task cards
- Evidence links
- Realtime authorization

Test responses:

- 200
- 400
- 401
- 403
- 404
- 409
- 422
- 429
- 500
- 502
- 503
- Timeout
- Offline/reconnect

Required:

FALSE SUCCESS RESPONSES: 0
UNHANDLED SERVER ERRORS: 0
RAW DATABASE ERRORS SHOWN: 0
SECRET LEAKS: 0

==================================================
9. SECURITY QA
==================================================

Test:

- Unauthorized conversation access
- Cross-user conversation access
- Modified conversation ID
- Modified message ID
- Realtime subscription without authorization
- Message injection
- XSS in message text
- Malicious attachment metadata
- Oversized upload
- MIME mismatch
- Rate-limit bypass
- Search enumeration
- Evidence endpoint enumeration
- Trace-ID guessing
- Audit-evidence tampering
- Client secret exposure
- Log secret exposure

Required:

CRITICAL FINDINGS: 0
HIGH FINDINGS: 0
CROSS-USER ACCESS FAILURES: 0
EVIDENCE ACCESS BYPASSES: 0
SECRET EXPOSURES: 0

==================================================
10. IVX IA SENIOR-DEVELOPER RESPONSE UPGRADE
==================================================

Do not postpone this behind physical-device QA.

Implement and test the IVX IA developer response pipeline independently.

Every developer response must be assembled from structured task records:

- Owner request
- Task ID
- Run ID
- Current commit
- Relevant files retrieved
- Production observations
- Root cause
- Files changed
- Commands executed
- Tests executed
- Device-QA status
- Commit
- Deployment
- Feature-verification status
- Evidence IDs
- Remaining blockers

Required response format:

DIRECT RESULT

WHAT WAS REQUESTED

WHAT WAS FOUND

ROOT CAUSE

WHERE THE DEFECT EXISTED

WHAT WAS CHANGED

WHY THE CHANGE ADDRESSES THE ROOT CAUSE

TESTS EXECUTED

PRODUCTION PROOF

DEVICE QA STATUS

FAILED OR UNVERIFIED ITEMS

NEXT OWNER ACTION

IVX IA must not call a feature VERIFIED when device QA is pending.

==================================================
11. IVX IA COMPLETION-VALIDATOR TESTS
==================================================

Run controlled tests:

A. No source inspection
Expected: NOT COMPLETED

B. Source inspected, no root cause
Expected: PARTIAL

C. Code committed and deployed, no device QA
Expected: PARTIAL — DEVICE QA PENDING

D. `/health` passes but feature test fails
Expected: FAILED

E. Automated web QA passes, Android/iOS pending
Expected: PARTIAL

F. Owner Android evidence passes, iOS pending
Expected: PARTIAL or VERIFIED only if owner formally accepts iOS as blocked

G. Every required test passes
Expected: VERIFIED

Required:

FALSE VERIFIED RESPONSES: 0
NARRATIVE-ONLY COMPLETIONS: 0
MISSING BLOCKERS IN RESPONSE: 0
STALE EVIDENCE ACCEPTED: 0

==================================================
12. PREPARE THE OWNER PHONE TEST PACKAGE
==================================================

Rork must prepare a simple owner-only testing package for the physical phones.

Provide inside IVX:

- “Start Android Chat QA” button
- “Start iOS Chat QA” button
- Seven-step checklist
- Automatic diagnostics capture
- Pass/fail buttons
- Owner comment box
- Screen-recording upload/reference field
- Export QA Report
- Submit Evidence
- Link evidence to exact commit and task

The owner should not need to inspect technical logs manually.

==================================================
13. RORK MUST COMPLETE BEFORE OWNER PHONE TEST
==================================================

Required pre-device values:

AUTOMATED COMPONENT TESTS:
SCROLL STATE-MACHINE TESTS:
DATABASE QUERY QA:
REALTIME QA:
PERSISTENCE QA:
AUTOMATED WEB QA:
PERFORMANCE QA:
API ERROR QA:
SECURITY QA:
IVX IA RESPONSE QA:
IVX IA COMPLETION VALIDATOR:
OWNER TEST PACKAGE:
GITHUB COMMIT:
PRODUCTION COMMIT:
ALL COMMITS MATCH:

All non-device items must be PASS before requesting the final owner phone test.

==================================================
14. OWNER-ONLY PHYSICAL DEVICE SCOPE
==================================================

The owner will perform only:

ANDROID

- Force close
- Reopen
- Open chat
- Confirm newest message
- Send
- Receive
- Read old history
- Paginate
- Return to latest
- Open keyboard
- Restart
- Upload screen recording and QA report

IOS

- Repeat the same test when an iPhone/build is available

Rork must ingest the submitted evidence and return the final verdict.

==================================================
FINAL VERDICT RULE
==================================================

Before physical phone evidence:

PARTIAL — ALL AUTOMATED QA COMPLETE, OWNER DEVICE QA PENDING

After Android and iOS evidence:

VERIFIED — CHAT OPENS AT THE NEWEST MESSAGE AND IVX IA SENIOR-DEVELOPER WORKFLOW IS OPERATIONAL

Only when every required acceptance criterion passes.

Do not mark web QA blocked without first using the IVX worker/CI browser automation.
Do not ask the owner to perform backend, API, database, security, performance, automated web, or response-quality testing.
Do not modify the deployed chat implementation again unless a specific automated or owner-device test fails.
